The person in respect of whom any amount is transferred to the IEPF, can make an application by filing webform IEPF-5 with the IEPF authority set up by MCA that shall further process the application. Application can also be made by any legal representative of the deceased person. Instruction Kit for form No. IEPF-5 E-Verification Report 3 | P a g e 1 PART I – LAW(S) GOVERNING THE WEBFORM Pursuant to Rule 7(3) of the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (Accounting, Audit, Transfer and Refund) Rules, 2016 1.1 Purpose of the webform IEPF-5 E- Verification Report aims to simplify the process for filing an e-verification report with The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (‘IEPFA’) by the company/bank. The company/bank within thirty days from the date of submission of claim, send an online verification report to the Authority after verification of details in Form No. IEPF-5 in the format specified by the Authority along with all the documents submitted by the claimant and shall attach the scanned copy of all the original documents submitted by the claimant in physical form duly certified by its Nodal Officer. 1.2 Important Check Points while filling up the webform ✓ Please read instructions and guidelines carefully before filling online application webforms. ✓ Please attach the required mandatory supporting documents in the specified format only. ✓ Please ensure that the company/bank is registered with MCA and have a valid and approved Corporate Identity Number (CIN) or Bank corporation Identification Number (BCIN). ✓ Please ensure that the person(s) signing the webform has a valid and non-expired / revoked DSC. ✓ Please ensure that the DSC of the signatory is registered on MCA portal against the PAN as provided in the webform. ✓ Please ensure that the PAN entered is valid. ✓ Please ensure that the Profile of Nodal officer and Deputy Nodal Officer should be updated under Business category of Nodal officer and Deputy Nodal Officer to access the IEPF-5 form to file E- Verification Report. ✓ Please ensure that SRN entered of webform IEPF-5 is valid and the status of the SRN

text: Frequently Asked Questions How Claims are Processed (FIFO) Claims are processed on a First In, First Out (FIFO) basis. However, your place in line is determined by when the company files its verification report (e-VR), not when you first submitted your claim form. For example, if two IEPF-5 forms are filed on the same date and their corresponding EVRs are received on different dates, the EVR received earlier will be the first in queue. Understanding Resubmissions A resubmission means your claim was sent back because it needs a correction or extra information. There are two categories: 1. Company-Level (e-VR Resubmission) • The Authority needs more details or documents from the company. • The company has 30 days to attend the query and refile the verification report. • Your priority in the queue stays the same, based on the date the original report was first received. 2. Claimant-Level (IEPF-5 Resubmission) • This usually occurs if your Demat account number is in incorrect format (it must be a valid 16-digit number without spaces or hyphens with first 8 digits being DP Id and last 8 digits unique client Id). • You have 30 days to refile the online form. • You must then print it, sign it, and mail it to the company. • You must also upload your mailing receipt. • Once the company receives your documents, they have 30 days to file their report. • If these 30-day deadlines are missed, the claim is marked as cancelled. Company Deadlines and Penalties The company must file a corrected report within 30 days. • They can file for an additional 45 days, but they will be fined 50 rupees per day. • If the company fails to file within 75 days total, your claim may be rejected. Monitoring Your Claim • You and the company will receive an automated email if a resubmission is needed. • You should check your spam folder

text: Offline payment process of MCA21 for IEPF-1 Form for “Pay Miscellaneous Fee” Step-1: Once user has paid the form fee, they have to click on Pay Miscellaneous Fee Option from Application History dashboard Step-2 :By Click on Pay Miscellaneous fee, user will navigate to NTRP portal Step 3: User has to select Investor Education Protection Fund from Dropdown Step 4: After selecting IEPF below screen will be displayed and user has to enter SRN of IEPF-1 based on SRN other details except particulars of the payment will be prefilled. Step 6: While making payment offline- User has to enable the pop up settings in system and complete the offline process until the depositor’s slip will be generated.
